# Soleto — Trattoria Italiana (Full Reference)

> Family-run Italian restaurant in Southampton, opposite the Mayflower Theatre. Head chef George Jiojioras serves fresh seafood, handmade pasta and premium steaks with Mediterranean passion.

## Contact

- **Address:** 11 Commercial Road, Southampton, Hampshire, SO15 1GF, United Kingdom
- **Telephone:** +44 23 8023 4044
- **Email:** info@soleto.co.uk
- **Website:** https://www.soleto.co.uk
- **Book a Table:** https://web.dojo.app/create_booking/vendor/bxU6ck62m7nZ2hSjU6_X9UfdHHqOIAn9Nfy8-GrJbI8_restaurant
- **Coordinates:** 50.909036, -1.409485

## Key Facts

- **Cuisine:** Italian, Mediterranean, Seafood
- **Price Range:** ££ (mid-range)
- **Founded:** 2017
- **Founders:** George Jiojioras (Head Chef) and Dominika Jiojioras (Front of House)
- **Location:** Directly opposite the Mayflower Theatre, Southampton's city centre
- **Private Dining:** Up to 14 guests seated in a dedicated private dining room at the restaurant
- **Private Catering:** Off-site catering for 30+ guests across Southampton, Hampshire and the surrounding area, by chef patron George Jiojioras; weddings, corporate events, anniversaries, milestone celebrations
- **Dietary:** Gluten-free pasta available for all pasta dishes; vegetarian options on menu
- **Service Charge:** Discretionary 12.5% added to the total bill
- **Reservations:** Accepted via website, phone or Dojo booking platform
- **Payment:** Cash, credit card, debit card accepted

## About — Our Story

Soleto is more than a restaurant — it is a family's love letter to the Mediterranean. Born from Greek roots and shaped by a deep reverence for Italian cuisine, every dish carries the warmth of tradition and the spark of something personal.

### George Jiojioras — Head Chef

George's journey began in the kitchens of Greece, where food was never just sustenance — it was the centre of family life. Growing up surrounded by the aromas of fresh herbs, grilled seafood, and slow-cooked stews, he developed an instinctive understanding of Mediterranean flavours.

His passion led him to Italy, where he immersed himself in the art of Italian cooking — learning to craft pasta by hand, master the delicate balance of a perfect risotto, and source the finest ingredients with uncompromising care.

Today at Soleto, George brings all of this together. His kitchen is one where Greek soul meets Italian precision, and where every plate is prepared with the same love and attention he learned at his family's table.

### The Kitchen

The kitchen is where the magic happens. Fresh seafood — oysters, lobster, Dover sole, scallops — takes pride of place alongside hand-rolled pasta, premium steaks, and dishes that change with the seasons. The daily specials board, handwritten by George himself, reflects what is freshest and most inspiring that day.

### Front of House

While George creates in the kitchen, Dominika ensures every guest feels at home. Together, they have built Soleto into a place where warmth and hospitality are just as important as the food. From the moment you walk in, you are welcomed into the family.

### The Space

Set on Commercial Road, directly opposite the Mayflower Theatre, Soleto occupies a space that is as warm and inviting as the food. Deep teal walls, gold-framed artwork, soft brass lamps, and white linen tablecloths create an atmosphere that moves seamlessly from relaxed afternoon lunches to intimate candlelit evenings.

### Daily Specials (From the Blackboard)

Each day, George selects the finest seasonal and market-fresh ingredients for the specials board. Typical specials include: Oysters, Mussels, Lobster, Crab, Dover Sole, Hake, Monkfish, Seabass, Tomahawk Steak, Fillet Steak, Rack of Lamb, Veal T-Bone, Clams, Polpette. Prices displayed on the blackboard daily.

Note: Gluten-free pasta is available for all pasta dishes. A discretionary 12.5% service charge is added to the total bill.

## Private Dining & Catering

Soleto offers two distinct private services:

### The Private Room (in the restaurant)

A dedicated dining room inside the restaurant at 11 Commercial Road, Southampton, separated from the main dining area. Used for intimate celebrations and corporate dinners.

- **Capacity:** Up to 14 guests seated
- **Setting:** Rich terracotta walls, crystal chandelier, gold-framed mirror, rustic wooden table
- **Occasions:** Birthdays, anniversaries, corporate dinners, milestone celebrations
- **Menus:** Bespoke, designed by chef patron George Jiojioras and agreed in advance
- **Location:** Directly opposite the Mayflower Theatre, central Southampton

### Private Catering (off-site)

Off-site private catering by George and the Soleto kitchen team, for groups of 30 or more, anywhere across Southampton, Hampshire and the surrounding areas.

- **Minimum group size:** 30 guests
- **Upper limit:** No fixed upper limit; arranged per event
- **Area served:** Southampton, Hampshire, South Hampshire and surrounding venues
- **Events catered:** Weddings, corporate events and away days, anniversaries, milestone birthdays, family celebrations, private dinners
- **Menu:** Designed in conversation with George — Italian and Mediterranean by default, with fresh seafood and hand-rolled pasta as house signatures. Full dietary flexibility (vegetarian, gluten-free, and others on request)
- **House signatures:** Fresh seafood (lobster, scallops, Dover sole), hand-rolled pasta, prime cuts (rib-eye, veal T-bone, fillet steak), Mediterranean classics
- **Enquiries:** Call 023 8023 4044 or email info@soleto.co.uk with guest numbers, date, dietary requirements and your venue or location preference

## Pre-Theatre Dining

Perfectly positioned opposite Southampton's iconic Mayflower Theatre, Soleto is the ideal setting for a memorable evening. Guests can enjoy a leisurely Italian meal before the curtain rises, or continue the night after the show.
